scope: Six original workstation concept images based on Docs/DESIGN_REFERENCE.md: Smithy, Loom, Tanner, Forge, Cooking Hearth and Brick Oven. Visual proposals only; not imported meshes, functioning stations, approved dimensions, or new recipe/cost decisions.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Elitewake pirate survival game placeable workstation concept, one isolated full asset.
Reference image 1: MATERIAL AND REALISM style reference only. Do not reproduce the boat.
Primary request: A compact freestanding blacksmith crafting workstation: substantial hand-built weathered oak workbench, a believable forged iron anvil securely supported on a reinforced timber block beside the bench, small manual vise, neatly placed hammer and tongs, a few metal blanks in an under-bench rack. Readable organized footprint and clear working surface. No furnace attached: the forge is a separate station.
Shared visual direction: grounded age-of-sail coastal survival, premium realistic 2026 Unreal game prop rendering, hand-crafted natural weathered oak, restrained oxidized wrought iron, natural leather/linen, rough stone and clay where appropriate. Physically based matte materials, realistic joinery and wear, muted earthy palette, serviceable not ruined. Each station is an original design, no copied game branding. Human-scale proportions, organized practical access and readable silhouette.
Composition: one complete station with its associated tools only, raised three-quarter view showing front working area and construction, centered in landscape canvas, entirely visible including chimney if present, generous margin. Neutral soft daylight lighting, no environmental scene.
Constraints: genuine TRANSPARENT alpha outside the station and individual supporting props. No rectangular ground slab, backdrop, building, scenery, person, pirate flags, skulls, fantasy ornaments, oversized mechanisms, steampunk, electricity, plastic, text, labels, logos or watermark. No dramatic sparks, bloom or smoke covering construction. Concept artwork only; do not invent recipe costs or station gameplay roles.
